visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a beige sleeveless top vigorously opens a large white shipping parcel filled with bubble wrap. Many small makeup items spill out onto a brown sofa. (2) She sits on the sofa with her arms extended, presenting a large pile of unboxed makeup products on the table before her in a bright indoor room. (3) The camera shows a close-up of a dusty pink velvet drawstring pouch being held and touched to demonstrate its physical texture. (4) The woman holds a black palette and a brush, applying a white highlight to her nose while looking into the palette's mirror. (5) A split-screen graphic appears: on the left, a close-up of her face with the nose highlight; on the right, a picture of a civet cat. (6) An extreme close-up of her eye area shows her finger applying a glittery, shimmering liquid eyeshadow to her eyelid and inner corner. (7) She looks directly at the camera, showing the finished look. Small icons of Japanese-style 'Gal' girls appear as overlays. (8) She looks down at a set of makeup brushes with a skeptical and disappointed facial expression. (9) A comedic meme clip shows her face superimposed onto a soldier in a barracks, shouting aggressively at others.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我買了這麼多彩妝品. [Variety]: 多到爆炸. (2) [Subtitle]: 全部只要一千元. (3) [Slogan]: 新款13支四季青化妝刷套裝 NT$59. [Variety]: 質感真的. (4) [Subtitle]: 品質真的不怎麼樣. [Variety]: 有強迫症不要買. (5) [Slogan]: PIPL閃耀雙色高光修容盤 NT$39. [Subtitle]: 我是直接變白鼻心耶. (6) [Variety]: 相似度 87%. (7) [Slogan]: SWEET MINT 珠光眼影液蠶絲筆 NT$18. [Subtitle]: 我應該買一個帶粉色一點點的. (8) [Variety]: 色系超衝突. (9) [Subtitle]: 但這個刷具讓我真的是無法理解. [Logo]: @HanHan.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long brown hair, wearing a beige sleeveless top.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A simple indoor setting featuring a brown sofa, a white table, and plain walls, with a secondary barracks setting in the meme clip.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female voice shouts excitedly over upbeat electronic BGM with strong percussion hits. The sound of plastic rustling from the parcel opening is prominent. (2) The voice continues at a rapid pace with rising intonation, transitioning to a descriptive narrative about the products. BGM remains constant with a synth-bass rhythm. (3) Vocal tone shifts to slight criticism with moderate intensity; the sound of fabric rustling is heard as she handles the pouch. (4) A metallic click from a palette opening followed by a short 'ding' SFX as she reveals her makeup effect. (5) Comedic cartoon sound effects accompany the visual transition to the animal comparison, while the BGM loops. (6) Vocal clarity is high as she explains her eyeshadow choice; BGM maintains a steady 4/4 beat. (7) A loud comedic meme SFX and aggressive shouting (high spectral tension) occur as the final edit plays, masking the BGM momentarily.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously review and critique a haul of extremely cheap makeup products, highlighting their low quality and unexpected visual results through comedic edits and comparisons.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear presentation of brand names and prices for multiple products during a review/haul format.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly dynamic short-form review that uses meme culture elements and fast-paced editing to engage the audience while reviewing budget cosmetics.
